name: Picnic
verdict: Dutch online supermarket (Picnic Technologies) funded by its shareholders, including Edeka, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust and Dutch family businesses; founded in 2015 by Michiel Muller, Frederik Nieuwenhuys, Joris Beckers and Bas Verheijen. Nothing found.
note: Dutch online supermarket. Rating note: Privately held; disclosed shareholders are Edeka, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust and Dutch family businesses (Silicon Canals, Jan 2024) — no full cap table published and no state or sovereign-fund shareholder identified in the sources found. No human-rights finding against Picnic found.
